‘Biranganar Bayan’ to stage 100th show today at BSA
2019-09-06T00:00:00+06:00 | Arts & Entertainment Desk
https://www.thedailystar.net/arts-entertainment/news/biranganar-bayan-stage-100th-show-today-bsa-1796050

Theatre troupe Shobdo Natyacharcha Kendra will stage their acclaimed production, Biranganar Bayan, for the 100th time. The show will take place at the Studio Theatre Hall of Bangladesh Shilpakala Academy (BSA) today, at 5 pm and later at 7 pm.

To celebrate their 100th show, Shobdo Natyacharcha Kendra arranged a list of programmes, including a seminar, discussion session and more. State Minister of Cultural Affairs, K M Khalid is scheduled to attend as the chief guest at the event.

Biranganar Bayan is written by Rowshan Jannat Rushni, who plays the protagonist of the play which is directed by Debashish Ghosh.
